<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 5:1:3">Y. B. Bath. V, beg. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>בשדה בור דלא מַשְׁגַּח עליה</he> in the case of an uncultivated field, about which the owner does not care (if people gather its spontaneous growth).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 3:8:8">Y. Snh. III, 21ᶜ</cite> top, <cite ref="C01175"><he>גְּסַס</he></cite>. Ib. VI, 23ᵈ bot. <he>מַשְׁגְּחִין רבנן מימר וכ׳</he> would the rabbis (you) mind to say a word of the Law? <he>אמרו ליה א׳ מרן</he> said they to him, would you mind? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 2:7:6">Y. Nidd. II, end, 50ᵇ</cite> <he>מאי חמא רבי משגח עלינן וכ׳</he> what reason had the master (you) to care for us (consult our opinion) this day? <cite ref="Sukkah 31a">Succ. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>ולא א׳ בה</he>, v. <cite ref="R00170"><he>צְוַוח</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sukkah 31a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>ולא אַשְׁגְּחִיתוּ בה</he> and you pay no attention to her? <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32:10">Gen.
